{{Quote|Where to now, Han?''"<br />"''First stop, planet Mazuma, where we'll find 200,000 credits at Lucre Cosminational Bank, courtesy of ''Rebel Fighter Command''!|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="The Flight of the Falcon" />}}
'''Mazuma''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="The Flight of the Falcon" /> located in the [[Mazuma system/Legends|Mazuma system]], within the [[Nuiri sector/Legends|Nuiri sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC" /> that was site of the [[Lucre Cosminational Bank]].<ref name="The Flight of the Falcon" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mazuma is a slang word for money, derived from Yiddish word mezumen (meaning "cash").
